metadata.title: Localization of weighted Goldman volume on $\mathrm{SL}(3,\R)$-Hitchin Component
metadata.abstract: We compute Goldman volume on the moduli space of convex real projective structures on a closed oriented surface of genus at least two, with exponential weight defined by the shifted Blaschke area. For every positive parameter, the integral converges and is a finite sum of inverse powers of that parameter. Its coefficients are intersection numbers involving the bundle of regular cubic differentials on the moduli stack of stable curves. The proof establishes absolute convergence and vanishing signed boundary integrals of the transgression under simultaneous plumbing degeneration. The pushforward of Goldman measure by the shifted Blaschke area therefore has a polynomial density on $[0,\infty)$, and its sublevel volumes are polynomial in the threshold.
metadata.comment: Preliminary version; all comments are welcome

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: Hitchin 模空间体积的定位公式
analysis.workSummary: 对亏格至少二的闭定向曲面的凸实射影结构模空间，计算以平移后的 Blaschke 面积为指数权的 Goldman 体积。作者称对每个正参数积分绝对收敛，并为该参数负整数幂的有限和，系数由稳定曲线模堆上正则三次微分丛相关交数给出；由面积推出的 Goldman 测度在非负半轴有多项式密度，次水平体积也为阈值多项式。
techniques: Goldman 测度与平移 Blaschke 面积
同时 plumbing 退化中的 transgression 边界积分控制
稳定曲线模堆上的交数
analysis.breakthrough: 把非紧 Hitchin 分量的加权体积转化为有限交数表达，并声称得到精确的多项式次水平体积而不只是渐近。
analysis.limitations: 适用于所述 SL(3,R) 凸实射影结构及正指数参数；平移量、归一化和边界退化时绝对收敛及带符号边界项消失的条件需查正文。稿件为初稿。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: Acknowledgment and AI-Use disclosure 明确披露研究期间与生成式 LLM 多次交流，帮助作者深入理解仿射微分几何及 Higher Teichmüller 理论。这里只明确背景理解与一般探索，未具体归因核心构造、证明、计算或写作，故保守标记 exploration。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.37317v1 · PDF 第 4 页 Acknowledgment and AI-Use disclosure

analysis.priorityReason: 非紧模空间、几何面积函数与精确体积公式相交，较有研究价值，但关键是退化边界控制。
